result.title: GameWM: Toward Next-Generation Video Games with Interaction-Centric World Models
result.summary: For more than half a century, video games have pursued better graphics, more natural interaction, and more engaging gameplay. Generative video models (VMs) now bear on all three. Neural networks already draw most of the pixels in shipped games, and recent world models let a lightweight game engine keep the world state while a VM turns the engine's coarse proxy video into final frames. These systems, however, treat the VM as a renderer that only restyles motion the engine has already authored, which leaves most of its generative capacity unused and limits the diversity a game can offer. We present GameWM, a design for next-generation games built on a clear division of labor. The GameWM-engine keeps what must be exact: rules, state, camera, and the layout of the world, which also spares the video model from having to remember it. The GameWM-VM generates what is expensive to author by hand: the look of the world and the detail of the player's interactions. One game mechanic can then be realized in many visually and physically distinct ways, while its outcome stays exactly as the engine computed it. To realize this division of labor, we build GameWM as a complete system: a data engine centered on interactions rather than exploration, an interface through which authored character sheets, scene art, and skill descriptions enter the model, and a model family from 5B to 33B parameters with a real-time causal variant for play. Together they give every player a fresh version of the same game: each player's own character, world, and skills turn the same engine mechanics into a new experience, while every event keeps the timing and outcome the GameWM-engine computed.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 GameWM 这一游戏系统设计：由引擎保留规则、世界状态、相机与布局等必须精确的部分，视频世界模型只负责生成画面外观与交互细节，并配套以交互为中心的数据引擎、创作内容接口，以及 5B 至 33B 的模型家族（含实时因果变体）。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「精确状态外置、生成模型只承担外观」的分工可作为反向对照线索，帮助核查任务必要信息是否必须留在 latent 状态中；但该工作不涉及 VLM 推理或 latent reasoning，联系较远，需较多核查。
